skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced academic reading skills, including understanding academic vocabulary, reading for main ideas, and critical analysis of academic texts.
Expand academic vocabulary through various topics and readings.
Apply critical thinking to analyze, synthesize, and evaluate academic information.
Work effectively in groups and pairs to solve reading comprehension tasks.
Demonstrate independent learning and self-assessment skills to enhance academic reading proficiency.
Master effective note-taking techniques for academic reading.
Develop skills to summarize and outline academic texts.
Manage time effectively to complete academic reading tasks.
Communicate effectively in academic discussions and presentations.
Conduct research and gather information from academic sources.
